definitions.gloss: to notify, to inform, to give notice
definitions.explanation: To formally communicate information, decisions, or changes to someone. Used for official notices from organizations, app notifications, and formal announcements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通知|つうち}する。
{合格者|ごうかくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通知|つうち}します。
examples.english: Successful applicants will be notified by email.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧にしたら、⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見逃|みのが}して→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: After I turned off app notifications, I missed an important message.

notes:
A formal word used in official contexts as well as in technology (push notifications). The noun form ⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧ is very common in both traditional and modern digital contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{通知|つうち}{書|しょ}→通知書：23842_tsuuchisho⟧: notice, notification letter
- ⟦{通知|つうち}{表|ひょう}→通知表：08604_tsuuchihyou⟧: report card (school)
- ⟦プッシュ{通知|つうち}→プッシュ通知：06477_pusshutsuuchi⟧: push notification
- ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: advance notice
- ⟦{通知|つうち}{設定|せってい}→通知設定：22571_tsuuchisettei⟧: notification settings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知|し}らせる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to inform, to let know — everyday native Japanese word
- {通知|つうち}する: to notify — formal, used for official or systematic notifications
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact — broader, includes any kind of getting in touch
